name: Couchbase

methods.name: get
methods.documentation: Get a binary value. Returns an array containing the value in the result property, or error details on failure. The timeout option is a non-negative integer in milliseconds.

methods.name: exists
methods.documentation: Check whether a document exists. Returns an array containing a boolean in the result property, or error details on failure. The timeout option is a non-negative integer in milliseconds.

methods.name: set
methods.documentation: Upsert a binary value. Returns an array containing result => true, or error details on failure. Options are expiry as non-negative integer seconds (up to 50 years), timeout as non-negative integer milliseconds, and durability (none, majority, majority_and_persist_to_active, or persist_to_majority).

methods.name: delete
methods.documentation: Delete a document. Returns an array containing result => true, or error details on failure. Options are timeout as non-negative integer milliseconds and durability (none, majority, majority_and_persist_to_active, or persist_to_majority).

methods.name: increment
methods.documentation: Increment a counter by a non-negative integer delta, defaulting to 1, and return its new value in the result property, or error details on failure. The initial option creates a missing counter with that non-negative integer value. Other options are expiry as non-negative integer seconds (up to 50 years), timeout as non-negative integer milliseconds, and durability (none, majority, majority_and_persist_to_active, or persist_to_majority).

methods.name: decrement
methods.documentation: Decrement a counter by a non-negative integer delta, defaulting to 1, and return its new value in the result property, or error details on failure. The initial option creates a missing counter with that non-negative integer value. Other options are expiry as non-negative integer seconds (up to 50 years), timeout as non-negative integer milliseconds, and durability (none, majority, majority_and_persist_to_active, or persist_to_majority).
